youtube.title: Xerxes demanded Sparta's weapons. Leonidas said 4 words 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Xerxes brought a million men to Thermopylae and told 300 Spartans to hand over their weapons. 🛡️

This is Sparta, so the reply was 4 words long.

Sparta or Persia? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Plutarch and Herodotus: in 480 BC Xerxes demanded the Spartans give up their arms and Leonidas answered "Molon labe" (come and take them); when told Persian arrows would blot out the sun, Dieneces said "then we'll fight in the shade."
